title: Data Combination: Interferometry and Single-dish Imaging in Radio Astronomy
question: Which interferometer plus single-dish data combination methods recover the true sky flux best, and how can their performance be quantitatively assessed (new A-par, fidelity, power-spectrum and spectrogram diagnostics)

data.bands: M100: ALMA Band 3 (CO 1-0, 115.271 GHz); Skymodel: simulated at 115 GHz
data.arrays: M100: ALMA 12m mosaic (47 pointings), 7m mosaic (23 pointings), SD on-the-fly map; Skymodel: simulated 12m, ACA 7m and SD

recipe.goal: Simulate ALMA observations of the skymodel
recipe.method: Run simobserve on the synthetic skymodel for 12m (two configurations), ACA 7m and SD, with multiple fields and days
key_parameters: 12m (7m): 52 (17) fields, each visited 30 (90) times per session, 10 s integration per field

recipe.goal: Prepare the M100 SD and interferometer data
recipe.method: Header manipulation, axis reordering and regridding of M100 12m/7m/SD data
key_parameters: Cube of 50 line channels plus 10 baseline channels on each side

recipe.method: tclean with Briggs weighting, mosaic gridder, 100,000 iterations and SD+auto-multithresh mask
key_parameters: Mask: >0.3 x SD max plus auto-multithresh

recipe.goal: Combine SD and interferometric data with each method
recipe.method: Feather, SDINT (sdintimaging), MACF (tclean with SD image as startmodel, then feather) and FSSC applied to skymodel and M100; TP2VIS implemented in the script but not evaluated
key_parameters: Standard (default-like) values for briggs, sdfactor (Feather, MACF) and sdgain (SDINT); numbers not given
MACF: SD image (Jy per pixel) used as tclean startmodel, then feathered with the SD image
assumptions: Flux scales of the interferometer and SD data are aligned; astrometry aligned; images corrected for PB response

recipe.goal: Assess image quality with A-par, fidelity, flux vs signal, power spectra and spectrograms
recipe.method: Pixel-by-pixel Accuracy parameter A=(I-R)/|R| and Fidelity inside an adaptive assessment mask, at the reference resolution; histograms, A-par vs flux bins, spatial power spectra (median in annuli of 2D FT) and per-channel A-par spectrograms
key_parameters: Assessment mask threshold 3 x RMS_mask (off-source RMS at native resolution), corrected for PB response and for beam ratio
A-par computed per pixel/voxel after convolving and regridding to the reference image beam and grid
assumptions: For the skymodel the reference is the true model; for M100 the reference is the SD cube

recipe.method: Compare A-par distributions, flux recovery per signal bin, intensity and A-par power spectra, and M100 spectrograms for int-CLEAN, Feather, SDINT, MACF (FSSC nearly identical to Feather)

not_stated_but_needed: Calibration of the M100 Science Verification data (manual vs pipeline, CASA version, flux scale) and which calibrated products/MS were used
Actual sdfactor / effdishdiam values for Feather and MACF, sdgain and dishdia for SDINT (paper only says 'standard values')
sdintimaging deconvolver, scales, thresholds, cell size and image size; tclean cell/imsize and stopping threshold
Power-law index and normalisation of the skymodel, and level of the added Gaussian noise in the simulated data
How the SD M100 cube and the skymodel SD image were generated/obtained (beam, units, header fixes) and exact regridding steps
Line-free channels and any continuum subtraction for M100
Values of the intermediate reference resolutions used for assessment (2'' versus 1.7'' stated inconsistently) and RMS_mask measurement region
Number of flux bins and binning scheme for A-par vs flux diagnostics beyond the 10-bin example
missing_for_reproduction: Numeric values of sdfactor/sdgain/effdishdiam/dishdia and tclean/sdintimaging threshold and cell parameters
M100 calibration details and which MS/SD products were used
Skymodel power-law index and noise level; random seeds
score_reason: Public code and data on GitHub plus an explicit recipe and many numeric A-par/flux-recovery results; several tclean/combination parameters and M100 calibration are left to the scripts.
rediscovery_reason: M100 SV data are public, the methods and metrics are clearly defined and the main results are numeric (A-par means, flux recovery fractions), though exact parameters must come from the released scripts.
